meta.title: ReviewBuddie – More honest reviews for Indian marketplace sellers

hero.eyebrow: For Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa & FirstCry sellers
hero.h1: Most of your customers never leave a review. Fix the reason, not the rating.
hero.sub: ReviewBuddie turns a QR code on your box into warranty registration, product guides and a simple review request, so happy customers actually speak up.

problem.h2: Your customers aren't unhappy. They're just silent.
problem.sub: Most buyers who like your product never say so. Nothing makes it easy for them.

reasons.title: They forget
reasons.body: By the time they've used the product, the order page is long gone.

reasons.title: It feels like effort
reasons.body: Open the app, find the order, scroll to the review box. Most stop halfway.

reasons.title: Writing is hard
reasons.body: They liked it, but don't know what to say or how to say it.

reasons.title: They don't know where to go
reasons.body: Nobody showed them where their words would actually help other buyers.

how.h2: How do I get more reviews on Amazon India without breaking the rules?
how.sub: Remove the hurdles. Ask at the right time. Let customers speak in their own words.

steps.title: Add the QR insert to your box
steps.body: Add your product in ReviewBuddie and print the QR insert. It goes in the box with every order. Nothing changes in how you pack or ship.

steps.title: Customer registers warranty and watches your guide
steps.body: They scan with their phone camera. No app, no login. They register their warranty and see your setup video or care guide.

steps.title: A timely, compliant review request
steps.body: Once they've had time to use the product, they get one neutral request to share their experience. If writing feels hard, AI helps them put their own rating and points into words. They edit it and post it themselves.

features.h2: What happens after the parcel arrives
features.sub: Four tools that work together, all from one QR code.

cards.title: Warranty registration
cards.body: A short form on the customer's phone: name, WhatsApp number and order ID. Every registration shows up in your dashboard.

cards.title: Product education
cards.body: Add setup videos, user manuals and care guides. Customers see them right after scanning, when questions come up.

cards.title: Review requests
cards.body: One neutral request at the right time, linking straight to your product's review page on the marketplace they bought from. Every customer gets the same request.

cards.title: Seller dashboard
cards.body: See scans, warranty registrations, guide views and review requests by product and by marketplace.

faq.h2: Questions sellers ask before they start

items.a: ReviewBuddie is built around Amazon's customer review rules. Every customer gets the same neutral request, nobody is offered anything in return, and we never filter who gets asked. Marketplace policies change, so we keep our flows up to date, and we suggest you also check the latest guidelines in Seller Central.

items.q: Do you give customers incentives for reviews?
items.a: No, never. No discounts, gifts, cashback or free products in exchange for a review. Warranty registration and product guides are part of the product experience, and customers get them whether or not they ever leave a review.
No. They scan the QR code with their phone camera and everything opens in the browser. No app download, no login.
Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa and FirstCry. The review request takes customers straight to your product's review page on the marketplace they bought from.
ReviewBuddie is free for founding sellers during early access. We'll share pricing well before launch, and you'll never be charged without agreeing to it first.
Add your product, upload your guides, print the QR insert and put it in your boxes. Founding sellers get personal setup help from our team on WhatsApp.
Customer details collected through warranty registration belong to you. We don't sell or share them with anyone, and customers can ask for their data to be deleted at any time.
Yes. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll walk you through it on a short call.
